title: The sharp Lipschitz continuity problem with respect to the pseudo hyperbolic metric
summary: The main purpose of this paper is to address an open problem posed by Huang, Rasila, and Zhu in [Anal. Math. 48(2022), 1069-1080]. We first establish a sharp Lipschitz continuity result for locally univalent harmonic Bloch mappings with respect to the pseudo hyperbolic metric. This result is then applied to demonstrate that harmonic $(K,K_0)$-quasiregular Bloch type mappings are Lipschitz continuous under the same metric, where $K\geq1$ and $K_{0}\geq0$.
